environment.test: isolated browser page at http://127.0.0.1:8123/smoke.html; no app, personal profile, account, or API key used
environment.method: Browser fetch from a local test page, 7-second per-request abort, requests sequential; sample titles/metadata inspected, image pixels not individually reviewed

Openverse.assessment: No browser availability evidence from this environment; existing app timeout is even shorter (3.5s), so the current integration appears unusable here. This does not establish that Openverse is globally unavailable.

Wikimedia Commons.assessment: Verified keyless cross-origin browser API responses with result metadata including license; all four result lists have plausible semantic hits. Search is keyword-oriented and metadata/title relevance is not proof of pixel content.

Flickr public feed.assessment: Keyless public-feed route failed browser fetch for all samples (consistent with CORS/access restrictions). Flickr REST search is separately documented as requiring an API key.

iNaturalist.assessment: API and CORS work, but free-text q=fox returned unrelated taxa in the five-item sample. It is an animal-specific source and would need taxon ID/autocomplete-based queries; photo licenses may be noncommercial (sample cc-by-nc), unsuitable if app use is commercial.

provider_policy_and_official_docs.notes: Official API documentation; anonymous access, registered OAuth client credentials, pagination and rate-limit response guidance. Keep client secret private; do not embed it in web app.
Official JS client docs; unauthenticated use and rate-limit/backoff guidance.
Official access policy; identify API client with User-Agent.
Official browser cross-origin API guidance; use origin=* for anonymous requests.
Official rate-limit guidance; limits vary by client and can change; respect Retry-After and throttle requests.
Official API docs include observation search query, photos and per_page.
Official developer guidance and request rate limits.
Official recommendations include conservative request frequency.
Official keyless public-feed documentation; smoke call failed from browser. Feed response did not establish an adequate license/rights workflow.
Official REST API overview; API key required for Flickr API access.
Official API requires registered app/access key; guidelines require key confidentiality and attribution.
Official FAQ uses api.data.gov API key; not keyless. CC0 coverage is not a broad stock-photo corpus.

recommendation: No verified new broad stock-photo provider surfaced. Wikimedia Commons was the only broad candidate with successful, relevant keyless browser results, and the app already integrates it; focus on improving query expansion, relevancy, image verification, and license attribution there. Openverse remains the strongest broad openly licensed aggregator on paper, but current browser requests stalled in this environment and its existing implementation returns 401 per prior pilot evidence. iNaturalist is a supplementary animal-only source after taxon resolution, with license filtering. Do not claim Unsplash/Pixabay/Flickr REST/Smithsonian are keyless; if chosen, use a server-side proxy with a private key, but that conflicts with no backend deployment.
